description.text: Biomedical Engineering (BME) is an interdisciplinary subject that integrates biology, medicine and engineering, aiming to solve practical problems in medical diagnosis, treatment, rehabilitation and health management through engineering and technical means. The course is based on "Principles of Life Sciences" and uses "Engineering Technology Methods" as a tool to cultivate students' abilities in designing medical equipment, developing biomaterials, analyzing biological signals and optimizing clinical processes. The goal is to produce compound innovative talents with both medical knowledge and engineering thinking.

duration.text: The Biomedical engineering at Guangdong University of Technology is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3472 USD/per year ￥ 25000 CNY/per year

materials.text: (1) A foreigner's ordinary passport valid for more than one year or a currently valid visa in China.(2) Highest academic degree certificate (original and notarized in Chinese or English). Fresh graduates can provide a pre-graduation certificate issued by their university. Those who fail to obtain their graduation certificates before enrollment will have their admission qualifications revoked.(3) A complete official transcript of the study stage provided by the highest academic degree school (original and notarized in Chinese or English).(4) Personal statement and a brief research plan (within 800 words). Applicants for doctoral programs are also required to submit a brief research experience.(5) Two recommendation letters from associate professors or those with corresponding professional titles or above.Applicants who studied in China during their previous educational stage are required to provide proof of their performance at school.(7) A pre-approval letter for acceptance issued by the graduate supervisor of the intended major (Attachment 3). Those who have not yet determined the pre-accepted supervisor and meet the application requirements will enter the interview and assessment process in accordance with the relevant regulations of the school's postgraduate recruitment.(8) Physical examination report (The examination results must have a valid official seal and be valid for 6 months).

requirements.text: Foreign citizens who are physically and mentally healthy and of good conduct. Applicants for master's degree programs must have a degree equivalent to a bachelor's degree in China, and applicants for doctoral degree programs must have a degree equivalent to a master's degree in China. No criminal record. During the study period in China, I voluntarily abide by Chinese laws and regulations as well as the school's rules and regulations, respect Chinese social morality and customs, and refrain from engaging in any activities that are inconsistent with my student status.
